channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula fala a aliados em reenviar nome de Messias ao STF, mas ala do governo avalia risco de nova derrota
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is considering resubmitting Jorge Messias’ name for the Supreme Federal Court, but fears another defeat in the Senate. A 2010 internal Senate rule blocks reappraisal of a rejected nominee within the same legislative session, making a 2026 vote impossible; any new review would only occur in 2027 if Lula wins re-election. Lula has not yet decided and continues to avoid meeting with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, whom the government holds responsible for the prior rejection.

item.title: Avaliação do governo Lula é pior em segurança
item.description: President Lula's government receives negative evaluations in the four priority areas identified by the population, according to a Datafolha poll released on March 17, 2025. The poorest assessment is specifically in the area of public security, reflecting voter dissatisfaction with the government's performance in this critical sector.

item.title: Lula não podia ser citado na “Globo”, diz biógrafo da emissora
item.description: Biographer Ernesto Rodrigues claims that Lula, as a union leader in the 1980s, had his name censored on Globo due to the economic impact of his strikes in São Paulo. Globo's coverage of Lula shifted from omission during the dictatorship to open opposition after the Mensalão scandal, passing through a pragmatic phase in 2002 when the network sought PT government support to overcome financial crisis.

item.title: DC confirma Joaquim Barbosa como pré-candidato à Presidência e Aldo Rebelo protesta: ‘afronta’
item.description: The Christian Democracy (DC) party officially confirmed Joaquim Barbosa, former STF minister, as its presidential pre-candidate for 2026, dropping Aldo Rebelo, former Chamber president, who polled below 1%. Rebelo protested, calling the decision an 'affront' and insisting he remains in the race due to his 'unstained biography' and congressional experience. Barbosa, who led the mensalão trial and backed Lula in 2022, has not yet publicly commented on the announcement.

item.title: No olho do furacão, Flávio deve ter DR coletiva com aliados nesta semana
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL’s pre-candidate for president, is expected to hold a press conference this week to clarify his ties with Daniel Vorcaro after Intercept Brasil published messages and audio in which he allegedly demanded money from Vorcaro to fund a film about Jair Bolsonaro’s biography. The scandal has damaged his credibility and raised concerns among allies that it could hinder his standing against President Lula in opinion polls. A meeting with PL deputies and senators aims to reassure allies and strengthen internal support.

item.title: Governo decide na 4ª feira se reduz ou eleva o custo de energia
item.description: The Lula government will decide next Wednesday (May 20, 2026) whether to lower or raise electricity costs by recalibrating the CVaR parameter, which measures risk aversion in the power sector. Currently set at CVaR 15/40 — considered highly conservative — the proposed adjustment to levels like 15.35 or 15.30 could reduce reliance on expensive thermal plants, lowering tariff flags and easing inflation and household budgets from 2027 onward, without compromising supply security.

item.title: A perda de credibilidade de Flávio Bolsonaro na Faria Lima
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro arrives in São Paulo for meetings with business leaders and bankers in Faria Lima, following a political scandal that has damaged his credibility. Originally intended to solidify his standing as the financial sector’s preferred presidential candidate for 2026, the meetings now aim to mitigate the fallout. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: Buscas por ‘taxa das blusinhas’ no Google batem recorde após governo zerar imposto federal
item.description: Searches for 'blusinha tax' surged 50-fold after the Lula government abolished the federal import tax on goods under US$50, announced on Tuesday, the 12th. Related queries like '50 dollars in reais' and 'how much is 50 dollars' also saw sharp increases. The tax, introduced in 2024 via the Mover project to support domestic industry, was widely unpopular despite government claims it benefited consumers by encouraging purchases from reliable companies.

item.title: Apesar de queixas de clientes e ações na Justiça, TCU e Aneel recomendam renovação de contrato da Enel
item.description: Despite customer complaints, civil lawsuits, and criticism from President Lula — who claimed Enel 'fulfilled nothing it promised' — the TCU and Aneel recommended renewing Enel’s contract. The final approval rests with the Ministry of Mines and Energy, while Enel asserts its service quality indicators exceed the national average. State deputy Flávio Serafini opposes the renewal, alleging data manipulation via regulated 'expurgos' and 'sacrifice zones,' and insists his civil action to block the renewal remains active.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio Bolsonaro esperam que mudanças no TSE ajudem a ‘blindar’ Dark Horse
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro hope that changes in the composition of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) will reduce the risk of suspension for the film 'Dark Horse,' which traces the political trajectory of Jair Bolsonaro. They believe the new TSE formation could create a more favorable environment for the documentary’s release, seen as strategically important for the 2026 presidential campaign.

item.title: Governo espera receita adicional de cerca de R$ 40 bi com petróleo em 2026, em cenário conservador
item.description: The Lula government projects an additional R$ 40 billion in revenue for 2026 due to rising oil prices under a conservative scenario, aiming to avoid creating a false sense of fiscal comfort. Officials fear that perceived revenue surplus could trigger immediate spending pressures, particularly from agribusiness, while stressing that fiscal targets remain challenging and prolonged conflict could increase expenditures beyond current plans. The upcoming bimonthly revenue and expenditure report, to be released on Monday (24), is expected to show an inflation projection rise to 3.7% — still within the 4.5% tolerance band.

item.title: ‘Instabilidade global coloca o Brasil no centro do mapa’, diz presidente do UBS no Brasil e na América Latina
item.description: The president of UBS for Latin America, Daniel Bassan, says global instability is reducing foreign investors' focus on Brazil's 2026 elections, calling the topic less relevant now than in previous electoral cycles. However, he notes that fiscal risk will likely return to the forefront after the vote, once results are known.

item.title: Por que no Museu do Amanhã? Jogadores vão? Entenda como funciona a convocação do Brasil para a Copa do Mundo
item.description: Brazil's head coach Carlo Ancelotti will announce the final 26-player squad for the 2026 FIFA World Cup at the Museum of Tomorrow in Rio de Janeiro, turning the event into a global celebration of Brazilian football with cultural performances and international media presence. Players typically do not attend in person due to club commitments abroad, and substitutions are allowed only for verified serious injuries before the tournament begins. The venue was chosen to accommodate more journalists and elevate the announcement beyond a procedural release.

item.title: Caso Vorcaro fura a bolha e pressiona Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The leak of audio recordings involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and banker Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master revealed demands for installment payments on the financing of the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro's life. The scandal intensified when it was disclosed that Eduardo Bolsonaro signed a contract granting him control over the film's budget and allegedly directed funds to a Texas-based entity, Havengate. The issue peaked on May 14, 2026, but remains significant due to concerns over the misuse of public and private resources in projects tied to the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: Cúpula de partidos do Centrão veem neutralidade como caminho após crise com Flávio e Vorcaro
item.description: The national leaderships of PP, União Brasil, and Republicanos are considering neutrality in the 2026 elections, allowing members to support any candidate following the scandal involving Flávio Bolsonaro and alleged negotiations with Daniel Vorcaro to fund the 'Dark Horse' film. Meanwhile, a dissident faction advocates for building an alternative right-wing presidential candidacy, proposing figures such as Tereza Cristina and Michelle Bolsonaro, though this idea has not yet been adopted by party leaders.

item.title: 'O voto nos estados': Moro aposta em acusações da Lava-Jato contra PT, que revida com excessos cometidos pela força-tarefa
item.description: Paraná gubernatorial candidate Sergio Moro (PL) is leveraging the Lava-Jato operation as a central electoral theme, accusing the PT of corruption and aligning with former prosecutor Deltan Dallagnol (Novo), while left-wing figures like Gleisi Hoffmann challenge the task force’s excesses. The race also involves Governor Ratinho Junior (PSD), seeking to install a successor amid Moro’s rising competitiveness after his return to Bolsonarism via party switch to the PL.

item.title: Apuração da PF sobre recursos para filme de Bolsonaro tem obstáculos e necessita de cooperação com os EUA
item.description: The Federal Police is investigating alleged transfers of approximately R$ 134 million from banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro, with part of the funds directed to a U.S.-based fund linked to Eduardo Bolsonaro’s lawyer. The probe faces jurisdictional hurdles due to the need for international cooperation to trace financial movements in the United States. Experts note that establishing a corruption crime requires proving political quid pro quo or improper advantage, which remains difficult to demonstrate.

item.title: Preocupado com palanques estaduais, Partido Novo pressiona e Zema reduz tom contra Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Romeu Zema of the Partido Novo softened his criticism of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro after internal pressure and concerns from bolsonarist allies about the impact on state-level alliances. He labeled the Vorcaro episode a "closed chapter," despite previously calling it "imperdoável." The shift reflects an effort to balance his anti-corruption stance with the need to remain competitive in states reliant on bolsonarist voters.

item.title: 'Imposto do Pecado' entra na guerra eleitoral e eleva pressão para Lula adiar PL das alíquotas
item.description: Lula's aides are resisting sending the 'Sin Tax' bill to Congress to avoid electoral wear and tear ahead of the 2026 presidential race. The proposal, which would regulate the implementation of the tax starting next year, is being delayed due to political pressure. The government aims to balance its economic agenda with the need to preserve political capital in a critical election year.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro mentiu e evidenciou falha no mercado
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro lied when denying he requested funds from Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master to finance a film about his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro. This false claim reveals an attempt to conceal the possible use of private resources for electoral purposes, potentially violating election laws and public ethics.

item.title: Datafolha: 70% veem relação entre Congresso e Lula mais como confronto do que colaboração
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on May 17, 2026 shows that 70% of Brazilians view the relationship between President Lula and Congress as more confrontational than collaborative, compared to only 20% who see greater cooperation. Conducted May 12–13 with 2,004 respondents, the survey also found that Lula’s government receives its highest approval for combating hunger and poverty (13%), while public security is the most criticized area. The poll is registered with TSE under BR-00290/2026.

item.title: A tortura que os EUA viram no Brasil
item.description: The report examines how supporters of Jair Bolsonaro, including military figures, called for the return of dictatorship in protests after the 2022 elections, while the former president serves punishment for attempting a coup. It highlights the book 'Olhares ianques: a ditadura brasileira nos arquivos norte-americanos' as recommended reading for Bolsonarists, suggesting that historical knowledge might, however remotely, encourage democratic reflection. The piece is subscriber-only and critiques authoritarian nostalgia within Brazil’s radical right.

item.title: Flávio vai a São Paulo para encontros com empresários após crise com Vorcaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) will travel to São Paulo for meetings with business leaders following a crisis involving banker Daniel Vorcaro and the financing of the film "Dark Horse". The trip aims to mitigate political and economic fallout and strengthen ties with the financial market ahead of his 2026 presidential pre-campaign.

item.title: PEC do BC, fim da escala 6x1 e Galípolo colocam governo Lula em semana de pressão no Congresso
item.description: The Lula government faces political pressure in Congress as the PEC to expand Central Bank autonomy advances, Gabriel Galípolo returns to the Senate’s Economic Affairs Committee to address interest rates and the Banco Master case, and a bill to reduce the 6x1 work schedule gains traction. Additional debates include tax exemptions for nonprofits, fiscal adjustment measures, and a potential meeting between Lula and Senator Davi Alcolumbre, amid ongoing resistance to the Central Bank PEC from within the economic team.

item.title: Lula diz que falha da democracia fortalece movimentos antissistema
item.description: Lula states that democracy's failure to meet basic needs fuels global antisystem movements and that leaders must deliver concrete results to counter this trend. He said it is not his role to change Trump's perception of Bolsonaro, but stressed the importance of maintaining cordial dialogue with the U.S. despite disagreements on Iran, Venezuela, and Palestine. Lula affirmed institutional respect with Trump, noting the U.S. president was democratically elected and calling him a 'good man'.

item.title: Custo de R$ 134 mi para filme de Bolsonaro “é até barato”, diz Eduardo
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro defended the R$ 134 million budget for the film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro, calling it 'even cheap' compared to Hollywood standards. Production stalled after the arrest of investor Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master, who had already transferred R$ 62 million, prompting Flávio Bolsonaro to demand the remaining funds in an audio leak reported by The Intercept Brasil.

item.title: Parte pequena do Brasil é polarizada, e força do PL é novidade, diz cientista político Jairo Nicolau
item.description: Political scientist Jairo Nicolau argues that while the polarization between Lula supporters and Bolsonaro backers dominates political discourse, it affects at most 20% of the Brazilian electorate, making it a phenomenon limited to a minority. His new book, 'O País Dividido', highlights the emerging strength of the PL as a novel factor in this landscape, suggesting potential growth beyond Bolsonaro’s traditional base.

item.title: Flávio posta texto do Poder360 sobre Lula e marca jornais
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) shared on X a Poder360 report about a December 2024 meeting between Lula and Banco Master owner Daniel Vorcaro, calling it a 'bomb' and tagging Globo profiles. The report claims Lula advised Vorcaro not to sell Banco Master to BTG Pactual for R$ 1, with attendees including future Central Bank head Gabriel Galípolo and government ministers.

item.title: Democracia Cristã confirma Joaquim Barbosa como pré-candidato à Presidência
item.description: Former Supreme Court Justice Joaquim Barbosa has been confirmed as the presidential pre-candidate of the Christian Democracy (DC) party following his affiliation with the party. This replaces the earlier pre-candidacy of Aldo Rebelo, who insists on maintaining his bid until the convention, possibly through legal action. DC national president João Caldas stated Barbosa embodies national unity and responds to the Brazilian society's demand for change.

item.title: ELEIÇÕES 2026: Lula, Bolsonaro e os Novos Nomes na Disputa?
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian elections are expected to feature Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Jair Bolsonaro as the main contenders, with potential new names emerging as alternatives in the presidential race. Although the political landscape remains polarized, there are signs of renewal and the rise of figures outside the traditional axis. Candidate definitions will depend on party alliances, popular approval, and judicial decisions that could still affect the eligibility of certain politicians.

item.title: 52% dos brasileiros são contra reduzir penas de condenados no 8 de janeiro, diz Genial/Quaest
item.description: A Genial/Quaest poll conducted from May 8 to 11 reveals that 52% of Brazilians oppose reducing sentences for those involved in the January 8, 2023, coup attempt, while 39% support it. The survey was carried out after Congress overturned President Lula’s veto on the sentencing guidelines bill, which sought to revise penalties for those convicted in the events.

item.title: Lula, idiotas antissistema, povo contra a democracia e quem quer o quê
item.description: Lula argues that democracy has failed by not meeting people's basic aspirations, allowing 'anti-system idiots' to gain applause worldwide. He references Yascha Mounk's 'The People vs. Democracy' to show how independent institutions and trade treaties constrain popular will in favor of economic and social elites, even in established democracies. While noting the cordiality between himself and Trump as a global exception, he warns of authoritarian tendencies masked as liberalism.

item.title: Ex-secretário de Lula é cotado para disputar vaga na Câmara pelo DF
item.description: Former Lula aide Marivaldo Pereira, who served in the Justice Ministry during previous PT governments, is being considered by the PT as a candidate for one of the Distrito Federal’s eight seats in the Chamber of Deputies in 2026. His profile is seen as institutional, with experience in legislative formulation, congressional relations, and access to justice. Ruth Venceremos, a former Secom advisor in the current Lula government and 2022 federal deputy alternate, is also mentioned as a potential candidate, with a background in social activism, communication, and culture, appealing to progressive sectors and social movements.

item.title: “Quem não estiver com Joaquim Barbosa está fora do partido”
item.description: The president of the Christian Democracy party (DC), João Caldas, announced former STF minister Joaquim Barbosa as the party's pre-candidate for president in 2026, replacing Aldo Rebelo due to Rebelo's poor polling performance. Caldas stated there had been an agreement to evaluate candidacy viability and that anyone not supporting Barbosa would be expelled from the party.

item.title: 'Não é caro para os padrões de Hollywood', diz Eduardo Bolsonaro sobre investimento de Vorcaro em 'Dark Horse'
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro defended that the R$ 134 million investment by Banco Master in the film 'Dark Horse', about his father Jair Bolsonaro, is not expensive by Hollywood standards, despite exceeding the budgets of 15 of the last 20 Oscar winners. He denied having spoken with banker Daniel Vorcaro about the project, although he signed an executive producer contract, which he called 'provisional and old', and said he used $50,000 of his own money to secure director Cyrus Nowrasteh.

item.title: Lula sinaliza a aliados querer insistir em Jorge Messias para o STF
item.description: Lula remains committed to Jorge Messias as his nominee for the Supreme Court, despite the Senate's rejection with only 34 votes in favor, claiming the defeat was orchestrated by Davi Alcolumbre to oppose the government. He believes Messias meets the technical qualifications and that the Senate overstepped by rejecting the nomination, though he acknowledges there is currently no political viability to push the appointment. Lula is expected to wait until October 2026 to decide on the vacancy left by Roberto Barroso, and if re-elected, intends to renominate Messias.

item.title: A nova pesquisa presidencial do Datafolha, a primeira após a revelação da relação Flávio/Vorcaro
item.description: Datafolha is conducting a presidential poll from Wednesday to Friday to measure voting intentions following the revelation of the relationship between Flávio Bolsonaro and businessman Vorcaro. Results will be released on Friday, the 22nd, and the article is exclusive to subscribers, requiring registration for full access.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro sobre Vorcaro: ‘Só oferecemos a exposição do filme para ele ser perseguido’
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro denied any quid pro quo in the donation from banker Daniel Vorcaro to the film Dark Horse, stating the offer was only for exposure, which would lead to persecution. He denied direct ties to Vorcaro and said he invested only $50,000 in the film’s early stage, while his brother Flávio Bolsonaro negotiated R$134 million with Vorcaro to finance the production. Federal Police are investigating whether funds were diverted to a U.S.-linked fund tied to Eduardo, used to support his stay in the U.S. after STF blocked his accounts.

item.title: Quaest: 52% dos brasileiros rejeitam redução das penas dos envolvidos no 8 de janeiro
item.description: The Quaest poll shows that 52% of Brazilians oppose reducing the sentences of those involved in the January 8 attacks, while 39% support it and 9% are undecided. Opposition is strongest among non-Lula leftists (72%) and independents (56%), and weakest among Bolsonaro supporters (31%). A majority (54%) believe the Dosimetry Law aims to reduce the sentence of former President Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lula usa o Washington Post para seduzir voto moderado no Brasil
item.description: President Lula gave an interview to the Washington Post targeting moderate and independent voters in Brazil, aligning it with his international diplomatic strategy. He aimed to rekindle the democratic appeal that secured his narrow victory over Bolsonaro in 2022, directing the message toward undecided domestic voters.

item.title: Ministro Mauro Vieira vai ao Japão nesta 2ª feira
item.description: Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira will travel to Japan on May 18, 2026, to attend the first Strategic Dialogue of Chancellors, a mechanism established during President Lula’s visit to Japan in March 2025. He will meet with Japanese Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi, sign two treaties on consular assistance and health services for persons with disabilities, and commemorate the 130th anniversary of the Treaty of Friendship, Commerce and Navigation. Bilateral trade reached US$11.6 billion in 2025, a 5% increase from the previous year.

item.title: Crusoé: A alternativa Barbosa e a falência da política brasileira
item.description: The nomination of former Supreme Court Justice Joaquim Barbosa as a presidential alternative for 2026 is interpreted as a symptom of the Brazilian political system's bankruptcy, reflecting a lack of new and credible leadership. His potential candidacy, already considered in 2018, signals desperation with current political options.

item.title: O limite eleitoral das emendas orçamentárias
item.description: The debate surrounding the 2026 general elections has focused primarily on the presidential race, with little attention given to proportional elections, which are decisive for the balance of power in the next government. Flávio Bolsonaro’s candidacy is under scrutiny due to his involvement with Daniel Vorcaro and the Banco Master case, potentially affecting his electoral viability. The renewal of the Chamber of Deputies is highlighted as a key factor in shaping post-election power dynamics.

item.title: Oposição explora desgaste de Lula em segurança, e governo exalta combate a crimes do 'andar de cima'
item.description: The opposition plans to exploit President Lula's lowest-rated area in public security, according to a Datafolha poll, to attack him in the 2026 campaign. The government, in turn, intends to highlight its actions against organized crime, especially the 'upper echelon,' and the legal frameworks sent to Congress.

item.title: Quaest: 52% dos brasileiros rejeitam redução de pena a golpistas do 8 de janeiro
item.description: 52% of Brazilians oppose reducing penalties for those convicted in the January 8 riots, according to a Quaest poll. Among independent voters, opposition rises to 54%, while 39% support leniency. Bolsonaro supporters mostly favor the measure, whereas non-Lulist left-wing voters reject it more strongly.

item.title: Lula vai indicar Messias… de novo
item.description: President Lula told allies he will insist on renominating Attorney General Jorge Messias to the Supreme Federal Court (STF), despite prior rejection. According to Crusoé, Lula is seeking support amid signs of weakening influence from Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) within the Judiciary. The move reflects the government’s strategy to strengthen its influence over the Court.

item.title: Crises em série com Master interrompem maré positiva de Flávio e testam campanha bolsonarista
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) pre-campaign suffered a setback after three cases linked him to Banco Master, interrupting his positive momentum and forcing him into a defensive stance. This crisis unfolds amid a political reaction from President Lula (PT), who is seeking to regain ground as the Bolsonarist candidate faces mounting challenges.

item.title: “Agora eu sou O cara do imobiliário do Texas”, diz Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro denies any financial or patrimonial link between the Mercury Legacy Trust, his lawyer Paulo Calixto, and the purchase of a Texas home for $753,500, accusing critics of attempting to damage his brother Flávio Bolsonaro's reputation. He claims there is no evidence of wrongdoing and that the allegations are a political 'trap'. The Federal Police are investigating whether part of the R$61 million paid by Daniel Vorcaro to the Havengate Development Fund was used to buy Eduardo's property and support his activities against the STF in the U.S.

item.title: Governo de Minas paga parcela de R$ 104 milhões do Propag à União
item.description: The Minas Gerais government paid the fifth installment of the Propag program, amounting to R$ 103.89 million, on May 15, 2026, bringing total payments under the program to R$ 512.2 million since joining in December 2025. The agreement restructured the state's debt with the Union, setting financial charges at IPCA plus 0% real interest, over a 360-month term, with commitments to contribute 1% of the debt balance annually to the FEF and make equivalent strategic investments. Since January 2019, Minas Gerais has paid R$ 13.42 billion to the Union for state debts, including R$ 6 billion under the Fiscal Recovery Regime (2024-2025).

item.title: Entenda a troca da PF no inquérito do INSS
item.description: The Federal Police changed the coordination of the INSS discount fraud investigation (Operation Sem Desconto) involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha). The shift occurred during the plea bargain of Mauricio Camisotti, who offered to return R$ 400 million to public coffers. While the PF calls it administrative, the move sparked criticism in Congress and the STF over lack of prior notice and potential interference in the probe.
